manifest.name: dsh-reply-forge-v3
manifest.description: DSH 桌面端插件 v3：直接写活会话（message projection），改完立即被大模型采信，不用重启；也可显式只落盘（重启后生效）

bundle.text:
# dsh-reply-forge-v3 bundle patch：向 web 组合挂载「回复锻造 v3」插件。
#
# 与 v1（dsh-reply-forge）、v2（dsh-reply-forge-v2）**完全独立**：独立插件 id、
# 独立客户端模块表条目、独立 localStorage 前缀（dsh-reply-forge-v3:*）、
# 独立样式前缀（rf3-）。三代可以分别启用，但**不要同时启用**——它们共用同一条
# 消息操作条，同时开会挂出多条（安装脚本默认会把更早的两代从 bundles 摘掉）。
#
# 只插入一个以插件 id 命名的条目，不修改任何既有条目，因此与其它插件
# 共享同一份组合树时不会相互覆盖。
- insert:
    - id: dsh-reply-forge-v3
      name: 'dsh-reply-forge-v3'

readme.text:
> [English](./README.en.md) · 简体中文
>
> 把 AI 说过的话改成你想让它说的，**改完立即生效，不用重启**。
> 思维链也能一起改。

DSH 桌面端（DeepSeek Harness）插件。会话里每条 AI 回复旁边多一个按钮，
点开就能改正文或思维链；改完写进去，**这个会话之后的每一轮，模型都只认你改过的版本**。

已收录 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)（DSH 生态精选列表，PR #7845 已合并）。

readme.section: 和 v1 / v2 的区别
readme.text:
|  | v1 | v2 | **v3** |
|---|---|---|---|
| 改的是什么 | 页面显示 | 会话落盘文件 | **活会话对象** |
| 模型看得到吗 | 看不到 | 看得到 | 看得到 |
| 生效时机 | 立即（只对本机） | 要重启 DSH | **立即** |
| 能改思维链吗 | 不能 | 不能 | **能** |
| 实现 | localStorage 覆盖 | 改写 `.jsonl.zstd` | message projection |

v3 把 v2 的落盘改写包成了**兜底分支**：会话在内存里就直接写活会话（立即生效），
不在内存里才落盘。

前两代是独立仓库，与 v3 完全独立（独立插件 id / 前缀，可分别启用）：

- **v2（dsh-reply-forge-v2，纯落盘改写）**：https://github.com/kinggod899/dsh-reply-forge-v2
- v1（dsh-reply-forge，localStorage 覆盖）：更早的第一代，仓库沿革见 v2 说明

readme.section: 和 v1 / v2 的区别
readme.text:
> 三代可以分别启用，但**不要同时启用**——它们共用同一条消息操作条，同时开会挂出多条
> （安装脚本默认会把更早的两代从 `bundles` 摘掉，见下）。

1. 鼠标移到任意一条 AI 回复上，点「伪造」按钮；
2. 在编辑器里选**目标**（可选本会话任意可编辑块——包括页面上看不见、折叠着的思维链）、
   选**写入方式**（默认「自动」）；
3. 改文本，点**写入伪造**。写入前会弹一次确认（复述这次会怎么生效），写完成功立刻可见。

改过的块还能**后悔**：点编辑器里的「**历史版本**」，能看到这个块的完整版本链
（原稿 → 每一次改写），选中旧版「还原到此版」→ 内容填入编辑器 → 再点一次
「写入伪造」即可。思维链同样有这条链。

两个出口：**仅本机渲染**（Ctrl+Enter，只改这一页的样子、模型看不见、可逆）与
**写入伪造**（改「模型看到的对话」，在线写活会话立即生效 / 落盘重启后生效，不可逆）。
完整的界面说明、写入方式对照表、常见问题见 [使用说明.md](./使用说明.md)。

| 写入成功，下一轮立即生效 | 思维链 | 三种写入方式 |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
|  |  |  |

三张连起来是一个真实片段：把一句 AI 回复改成「因为我是吃白饭的大肥鱼。」写进去，
块上立刻亮绿色回执——「下一轮对话模型就看到改后的内容（不用重启），焦点已交还输入框」。
下一轮随口问一句「你去干嘛」，模型接的是「虽然是个**吃白饭的**」——它真的信了。
中间那张是思维链的编辑面板：目标下拉里的 `seq=38 块0` 就是页面上折叠着、看不见的那串
内心戏，和正文一样能改。右边那张是写入方式三选：**自动**（会话在内存里就直接写活会话、
不在才落盘，推荐）、**仅在线（立即生效）**、**仅落盘（重载后生效）**。

readme.section: 关掉插件会不会把会话弄坏
readme.text:
**标记齐全就不会**——这个「不会」有前提。

`reply-forge/patch` 是宿主不认识的事件类型，宿主持久化层的准入闸门
`validateStoredEvents` 规定：未知类型且信封没带 `ignorable: true` → 抛错、
**整条日志拒读**（会话打不开）；投影层（插件在场时）对不认识的事件则直接跳过、
不报错，伪造退回原文。宿主自己的注释写明了这条路（`known-event-types.js`）：

> The persisted `SessionEvent.ignorable` marker is the compatibility mechanism.

readme.section: 关掉插件会不会把会话弄坏
readme.text:
于是分三种情况：**标记正确 + 冷启动**（插件不在）→ 会话照常打开、伪造静默退回原文；
**缺标记**（早期写入或写盘损坏）→ 被闸门拒读，用修复工具补标记；**插件在 DSH
运行时被热卸载** → 宿主抛 `session message projection "reply-forge/patch" was
removed`（所以正常用法都要求重启 DSH，重启后干净重放，碰不到这条）。

v3 的 P0 工作就是把「标记正确」钉死：在线/落盘两条写路径进入宿主持久化前统一补
`ignorable: true`；每次真写前核验写句柄（`WRITER_NOT_ROUTED` 可安全回落盘、
`APPEND_UNSAFE` 一律拒绝，失败码表见 [PLAN.md](./PLAN.md)）；真宿主持久化闭环
测试 create → append → flush → 重读 → 闸门放行全过。

[dsh-chat-thinking-editor](https://github.com/yumiao-dev/dsh-chat-thinking-editor)
是本插件重要的**学习对象**——它是 DSH 生态里最早做「思维链编辑」的探索者，
「改完立即生效」这个目标与它对用户的坦诚（PR 说明里明确写
「编辑过的会话包含插件自有事件，卸载插件后该会话可能无法读取」）都给了我们
直接的启发。两条路线的差别在技术选择：它早期版本把编辑挂在 `assistant/message`
上并带 `surfaceOp`，那类事件在插件缺席时仍会被宿主做 surface 校验，校验不过就抛；
v3 因此走了另一条路——自有事件 + 同类型 projection + `ignorable` 标记
（见上一节）。没有高下之分，只是约束下的不同取舍；站在它的肩膀上，
我们把「卸得干净」这件事做得更彻底了一点。

**万一会话已经被弄坏**：**退出 DSH**，双击 `修复会话.bat` 先看诊断（只读，不动文件），
确认后再 `修复会话.bat apply` 补上 `ignorable: true`——工具先备份、只改有毒行、
写完自读复验、修不好自动还原、修不了的旧伤明确报出而不是硬改。关插件的完整说明与
安全排障见 [使用说明.md](./使用说明.md)。

前提：已装 DSH 桌面端。两条路线选一条，装完都要**完全退出并重启 DSH**
（静态配置只在启动时加载）。

readme.section: 路线一：npm（最省事，不需要额外装 Node.js）
readme.text:
在 DSH 的「插件管理器」里输入包名 `dsh-reply-forge-v3` 点安装；或者关掉 DSH 后
在终端执行：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-reply-forge-v3
```

插件管理器还支持切换安装源（npm 官方源 / 中国大陆镜像源 / 自定义地址），
内网或私有源环境也能装。

readme.section: 路线二：zip 解压（需要 Node.js）
readme.text:
**双击 `安装插件.bat`**。

安装/启用/关闭/修复四个 bat 靠 Node.js 改静态配置——bat 会自动探测 PATH、
`C:\Program Files\nodejs`、`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\nodejs` 与 **DSH 自带的 node**
（`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\...\node\bin\node.exe`，装了 DSH 就有）共四处，
一般装过 Node 或 DSH 就能直接用。没有 Node 也不挡路：bat 会印出完整的手动四步
（改 package.json / cordis.patch.yml / 建 junction），照做即可。
插件本身跑在 DSH 内部，不要求你额外装运行时。

脚本只做三件事：建 junction、写 `package.json` 的 `bundles` 与 `dependencies`、
手工登记 lockfile 条目。它**不执行 `pnpm install`** —— 在 DSH 运行时跑 pnpm
会清空 `node_modules`。

readme.section: 路线二：zip 解压（需要 Node.js）
readme.text:
安装时会默认把更早的两代（`dsh-reply-forge-v2`、`dsh-reply-forge`）从 `bundles`
里摘掉：三代共用同一条消息操作条，同时开会挂出多条。它们的依赖和链接都保留，
随时可以用各自的「启用插件.bat」开回；想并存做对比就用
`node scripts/install.mjs --keep-v2 --keep-v1`。

其他脚本：

| 脚本 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `安装插件.bat` | 首次安装（含链接、依赖、lockfile、bundles） |
| `启用插件.bat` | 已装过但被关掉时，把插件加回 `bundles` |
| `关闭插件.bat` | 从 `bundles` 摘掉。启动异常时用它一键回滚 |

三个脚本都只改静态配置，都不碰 `pnpm`，都不会删你的覆盖数据；
**改完都要重启 DSH**（原因见上一节）。

宿主不允许对 `assistant/message` 做 surface replacement ——
`assertSourceEventReferences` 要求 replace 事件用 `sourceEventSeqs` 覆盖全部被遮蔽节点，
同一个函数又硬性禁止 `assistant/message` 携带 `sourceEventSeqs`。两条约束互斥，
必然抛错。

宿主为此留的正门是 **message projection**：按事件类型注册的纯函数，折叠时决定
「某个 seq 的消息模型看到的是什么」。所以 v3 追加一条自有的
`reply-forge/patch` 事件（纯日志记录，不进 surface），再由同类型的 projection
把目标消息改写掉。

- 事件不带 `surfaceOp` / `sourceEventSeqs`，所以不触发任何 surface 校验；
- 插件被禁用时，事件被静默跳过，伪造**退回原文**；只要标记齐全，会话照常打得开；
- 重启后伪造仍在：会话恢复用的是已注册的 projection 列表，而本插件在
  `apply()` 里同步注册；
- 在线写入的事件最终同样落进 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd`，所以「在线写的」和
  「落盘写的」一样耐久。但宿主持久化层**会校验**事件类型：未知类型必须带
  `ignorable: true` 否则拒读整条日志，而 `Session.append()` 不接这个字段——
  所以 v3 在写路径上包了 shim，进入宿主持久化前统一补标记
  （详见上面「关掉插件会不会把会话弄坏」）。

**关于宿主升级（v3.4.1 起）**：宿主 0.2.1 在读 v3 世代的旧会话文件时会做格式迁移，
把「未知类型 + `ignorable`」的事件改名成 `plugin:<原类型>` 写盘——我们的
`reply-forge/patch` 会变成 `plugin:reply-forge/patch`。投影是按类型精确匹配的，
所以本插件**两种类型都注册、读侧都接受**（`projectedTextsOf` 投影基准与版本血统
推导同样双类型）；新事件仍写旧类型，不触发改名。升级过 DSH 的老用户，旧会话里的
伪造与版本链都还在。

完整论证、宿主源码证据、失败码表见 [PLAN.md](./PLAN.md)。

readme.section: 三条写入出口，按代价从小到大
readme.text:
| 出口 | 改的对象 | 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| **改待发送队列** | 还没发给模型的消息（inbox） | **无**：消息未进日志，无新事件、不动已提交字节、`sessionId` 不变、provider 缓存不受影响 |
| 在线 patch | 会话日志里的历史消息 | 追加自有事件；改动点之后的 KV 缓存作废 |
| 落盘改写 | 会话记录文件 | 需备份还原；**运行中的宿主不读盘**，改了要下次载入才生效 |
| 仅本机渲染 | 只有页面看得见 | 模型看不见，纯障眼法 |

第一条是 v3.1 之后补的，走官方 `session.updateQueue(itemId, { kind: 'edit',
content: [...] })`。入口挂在带 `data-pending-steering` 的气泡上（回合进行中
以 steering 形式插入的消息；`next-turn` 排队消息不渲染气泡，用户看不见，所以
不提供入口）。

readme.section: 三条写入出口，按代价从小到大
readme.text:
**定位方式是文本回匹，这是宿主的限制不是偷懒**：气泡 DOM 上没有任何 id 类
属性（只有 `data-pending-steering` / `data-submission-echo` 两个布尔），
`itemId` 只能拿气泡文本去比队列行文本。因此：

- 匹到多条一字不差的相同文本 → **拒绝**并提示，不赌第一条；
- 行内含非 text 块（附件）→ **拒绝**，因为服务端只接受纯文本，静默改写会丢附件；
- 定位失败 → 不给输入框，只说明原因，避免「保存了却不知道改的是哪条」。

错误码表逐个核对过宿主 `dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js` 的
`updateQueue` handler（822-845 行），不是照抄别家插件。

readme.section: 版本血统：为什么不给事件加「旧文本」字段
readme.text:
「历史版本 / 还原到此版」（v3.4）刻意**不给 patch 事件加任何字段**——原稿本来
就没被破坏（patch 是独立事件，原始 `assistant/message` 一字未动），每条 patch 又
记着「改成什么」，投影折叠是「后者覆盖前者」；三者都在日志里，按事件顺序排起来
就是完整版本链。所以血统是**纯推导**（`src/lineage.mjs`），只在用户点开面板时
算一次——扫描、投影、写入路径上一个字节都没多付。「还原到此版」也不引入第二条
写路径：它只把旧版文本填回编辑器，真正写入仍走「写入伪造」（两步确认、陈旧
校验、自动备份全部复用）。

代价说清：「**仅落盘**」写入的块没有版本链——那条路（v2 原路）原地改写记录
文件，原稿只在 `.bak-forge-*` 备份里；在线写入落盘有数百毫秒滞后，此刻读链
可能差最新一版。

```bash
node tests/projection.test.mjs   # 在真宿主 dsh-session 上验证机制（找不到宿主会 SKIP）
node tests/persistence.test.mjs  # P0 真宿主持久化闭环：create→append→flush→重读→闸门
node tests/ignorable.test.mjs    # P0：ignorable shim + 每会话写句柄核验
node tests/live.test.mjs         # 在线层校验与失败码

共 **423 项 / 17 套**（含 P0 的 `ignorable` 29 项、`persistence` 真宿主闭环 5 项、
`session-repair` 15 项、v3.4 的 `lineage` 22 项、v3.4.1 的 `migration-rename` 5 项、
升级自检自身 `verify-host` 21 项）。
其中 **31 项**（`projection` 18 + `migration-rename` 5 + `persistence` 5 +
`ignorable` 3）需要本机装有宿主包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` 及 codec 链——找不到就 SKIP、不计失败
（此态执行 392 项），所以发行包在没装 DSH 的机器上也能跑绿；装了宿主的机器上才是
完整 423 项全跑。
跑法：逐个 `node tests/<文件>`，或 `node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"` 看总门禁。改过
`.dsh-plugin/client/*.mjs` 后必须重跑 `node scripts/build-client.mjs`（自研内联器，
零依赖 / 无 JSX / 无 export default），`build.test.mjs` 会校验产物与源码一致。

宿主升级可能**静默**改变插件依赖的接口（v3.4 修的「迁移改名」就是这么爆发的：
不报错、无提示，伪造退回原文）。升级 DSH 后，在插件源码目录跑：

```bash
npm run verify-host        # T0 版本基线 + T1 契约面（含强制跑宿主门控测试，缺宿主=FAIL）
node scripts/verify-host.mjs --boot   # + T2 启动冒烟
node scripts/verify-host.mjs --live   # + T3 活体 CDP
```

版本与发布时钉住的 `host-baseline.json` 不一致 → WARN（通常无害，登记新基线即可）；
任一层不过 → FAIL，退出码 1。完整说明见 [使用说明.md](./使用说明.md) 第七节。

| 命令 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `node scripts/build-client.mjs --check` | 产物与源码字节一致（改了源码没重建就失败） |
| `node scripts/lint-flat.mjs` | **拍平守卫**：客户端模块的顶层标识符是否跨模块重名（拍平成单文件后会静默互相覆盖，语法检查抓不到），以及是否用了内联器不支持的语法 |
| `node scripts/build-client-esbuild.mjs` | **esbuild 后端（可选）**：默认只写预览 `client.esbuild.js`，加 `--write` 才覆盖主产物 |

`build-release.mjs` 出包前会强制跑前两道守卫，失败即中止、`dist/` 不动。
esbuild 产物已实测与自研内联器**行为等价**（`tests/client.test.mjs` 57/57 全过，
导出 `{ name, inject, apply }` 一致），但它需要 `npx` 联网取包，所以默认仍是
零依赖的内联器；切换请当成一次显式决定（`--write`），不是手滑。

不想开界面时可以直接改文件（需要先退出 DSH）：

```bash
node scripts/forge-session.mjs --session <会话id> --list
node scripts/forge-session.mjs --session <会话id> --list --kind reasoning   # 列出思维链
node scripts/forge-session.mjs --session <会话id> --seq 42 --block-index 1 \
  --kind text --text "改后的正文" --dry-run

`--kind` 取 `text` / `reasoning` / `both`（默认 `text`）；`--list` 按它过滤，
改思维链前先用 `--list --kind reasoning` 拿到 seq/blockIndex。完整说明见
[使用说明.md](./使用说明.md)。

`scripts/diag-focus.mjs` —— 无人值守复现「保存后输入框没光标」：在 Node 里
照抄 App 启动配方 `boot()` 起真宿主（合并 app 运行时树 + profile 插件依赖的

**Forge what the model sees.**

Edit any reply in a live DSH session — or any thinking block behind it — and from the very
next turn, **your version is the conversation history**. The model doesn't just display your
words; it *remembers* them. No restart. No refresh-and-it's-gone. No re-reading a log to
check whether it took.

> 中文说明请见 [README.md](./README.md)；完整使用手册见
> [使用说明.md](./使用说明.md)（Chinese）

[](package.json)
[](#tests)
[](https://github.com/kinggod899/dsh-reply-forge-v3)

A plugin for the DSH desktop app (DeepSeek Harness). Every assistant message gets a
**Forge** button — hover, click, rewrite the reply or the hidden chain-of-thought, write
it back. Everything after that turn reads what you wrote.

Featured in [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin), the curated DSH plugin list (PR #7845, merged).

| | v1 | v2 | **v3** |
|---|---|---|---|
| What it edits | what's on screen | the session log on disk | **the live session object** |
| Visible to the model | no | yes, after restart | **yes, immediately** |
| Thinking chains | no | no | **yes** |
| Mechanism | localStorage overlay | rewrite `.jsonl.zstd` | message projection |

v3 keeps v2's disk rewrite as its **fallback branch**: session alive in memory → write the
live session (takes effect at once); not in memory → rewrite the log (takes effect on next
load).

The other generations live in their own repos and can coexist (separate plugin ids and
prefixes) — just never all three at once, they share one message action bar:

- **v2 (disk-only rewrite)**: https://github.com/kinggod899/dsh-reply-forge-v2
- v1 (localStorage overlay): the first take, its story is told in v2's docs

1. Hover any assistant reply → hit **Forge**.
2. In the editor: pick a target (any editable block in the session — including folded-away
   thinking blocks you can't click on screen) and a write mode (default: auto).
3. Rewrite, hit **Forge**. A confirmation spells out exactly what will happen; then it's
   done and visible.

Already-forged blocks can be **taken back**: hit **History** in the editor to see the
block's full version chain (original → every rewrite); pick an older version, hit
**Restore this version** (fills the editor), then **Forge** once more. Thinking chains
get the same chain.

Two exits: **Render locally** (Ctrl+Enter — this page only, invisible to the model,
reversible) and **Forge** (the model's copy — immediate online or on-reload via disk).
Full UI reference, the write-mode table and troubleshooting are in
[使用说明.md](./使用说明.md) (Chinese docs; English docs are on the roadmap).

| Written in — next turn reads it | Thinking chains too | Three write modes |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
|  |  |  |

One unedited session, three frames: an assistant reply is rewritten to
"因为我是吃白饭的大肥鱼。" — the green receipt lights up ("the model sees your version
next turn, no restart; focus handed back to the composer"). Ask it anything next turn
and it answers **as a freeloader fish**. Middle: the editor for a thinking block —
`seq=38 块0` in that dropdown is the folded-away monologue you never see on screen.
Right: the write modes — **auto** (live write when the session is in memory, disk
otherwise — recommended), **online only**, **disk only**.

readme.section: Will disabling the plugin corrupt my sessions?
readme.text:
`reply-forge/patch` is an event type the host doesn't know. The persistence gate
`validateStoredEvents` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence`) refuses the **entire
log** — session won't open — when an unknown event type arrives without `ignorable: true`
on its envelope. The projection layer (plugin present) just skips unknown types: no error,
the forge silently falls back to the original text. The host's own comment spells it out
(`known-event-types.js`):

readme.section: Will disabling the plugin corrupt my sessions?
readme.text:
> The persisted `SessionEvent.ignorable` marker is the compatibility mechanism.

Three cases: **markers right + cold start** → session opens fine, forges fall back
silently; **missing markers** (early writes or a torn write) → gate refuses, repair tool
fixes; **hot-unload while DSH is running** → the host throws
`session message projection "reply-forge/patch" was removed` (normal usage always
restarts DSH, which replays everything cleanly — you'll never hit this).

readme.section: Will disabling the plugin corrupt my sessions?
readme.text:
v3's P0 work is making "markers right" structurally true: both write paths (online and
disk) go through a shim that stamps `ignorable: true` before the host persists anything;
every real write re-verifies the session's write handle (`WRITER_NOT_ROUTED` safely falls
back to disk, `APPEND_UNSAFE` is always rejected — full failure-code table in
[PLAN.md](./PLAN.md)); the persistence loop (create → append → flush → re-read → gate
opens) is covered by tests against the real host.

readme.section: Will disabling the plugin corrupt my sessions?
readme.text:
**If a session is already broken**: quit DSH, double-click `修复会话.bat` for a read-only
diagnosis, then `修复会话.bat apply` to stamp the markers — backup first, only toxic lines
touched, self-read verified after write, auto-revert on failure, unreparable damage
reported plainly instead of forced.

[dsh-chat-thinking-editor](https://github.com/yumiao-dev/dsh-chat-thinking-editor) is an
important **reference** for this plugin — the earliest explorer of thought-chain editing
in the DSH ecosystem, whose live-edit goal and unusual honesty toward users (its PR notes
flatly state that edited sessions may become unreadable after uninstall) taught us a lot.
The difference is technical: it anchors edits on `assistant/message` with `surfaceOp`,
and the host still surface-validates those events when the plugin is absent — failing
that, it throws. v3 went the other way: private event + same-type projection +
`ignorable` marker (above). No hierarchy — just different trade-offs. Standing on its
shoulders, we pushed "uninstalls cleanly" a bit further.

Prerequisite: the DSH desktop app. Pick one of the two routes; either way you must
**fully quit and restart DSH** afterwards (static config is only read at startup).

readme.section: Route 1: npm (easiest, no extra Node.js needed)
readme.text:
Type the package name `dsh-reply-forge-v3` into DSH's plugin manager and install; or quit
DSH and run:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-reply-forge-v3
```

The plugin manager can also switch registries (npm official / mainland China mirror /
custom URL), so private-registry setups work too.

Double-click `安装插件.bat`.

The four `.bat` tools edit static config with Node.js — they probe PATH,
`C:\Program Files\nodejs`, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\nodejs`, and **DSH's bundled node**
(`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\...\node\bin\node.exe` — it ships with DSH). No Node
either? The bats print the full manual four steps (package.json, cordis.patch.yml,
junction) and you follow them by hand. The plugin itself runs inside DSH — no extra
runtime.

The script does exactly three things: create the junction, write `bundles` and
`dependencies` into `package.json`, hand-register the lockfile entry. It never runs
`pnpm install` — doing that under a running DSH wipes `node_modules`.

By default the installer drops the two earlier generations from `bundles` (they share
one message action bar). Their deps and links stay; re-enable them any time with their
own `启用插件.bat`, or keep them side by side for comparison with
`node scripts/install.mjs --keep-v2 --keep-v1`.

Other scripts:

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `安装插件.bat` | first install (junction, deps, lockfile, bundles) |
| `启用插件.bat` | put the plugin back into `bundles` when disabled |
| `关闭插件.bat` | remove from `bundles` — one-click rollback when DSH misbehaves |

All three only touch static config. None of them run `pnpm`. None of them delete your
overrides. All of them need a DSH restart afterwards (see above).

The host refuses to let `assistant/message` carry a surface replacement —
`assertSourceEventReferences` demands that a replace event cover every shadowed node with
`sourceEventSeqs`, and the very same function hard-forbids `assistant/message` from
carrying `sourceEventSeqs`. The two constraints are mutually exclusive; it always throws.
The full argument, with host source evidence, is in [PLAN.md](./PLAN.md).

readme.section: Three write paths, ordered by cost
readme.text:
| Path | What it changes | Side effects |
|---|---|---|
| **Edit the pending queue** | a message not yet sent to the model (inbox) | **None** — the message never entered the log: no new event, no committed bytes touched, `sessionId` unchanged, provider cache untouched |
| Online patch | a historical message in the session log | Appends a private event; KV cache after the edit point is invalidated |
| On-disk rewrite | the session record file | Needs backup/restore; **a running host does not read the disk**, so the change only applies on next load |
| Local-only render | only what the page shows | The model never sees it — pure sleight of hand |

readme.section: Three write paths, ordered by cost
readme.text:
The first one was added after v3.1 and goes through the official
`session.updateQueue(itemId, { kind: 'edit', content: [...] })`. Its entry point
hangs on bubbles carrying `data-pending-steering` (messages injected as steering
mid-turn; `next-turn` queued messages render no bubble, so users never see them
and no entry is offered).

readme.section: Three write paths, ordered by cost
readme.text:
**Locating the item is done by matching text, and that is a host limitation, not
laziness**: the bubble DOM carries no id-like attribute at all (only the two
booleans `data-pending-steering` / `data-submission-echo`), so `itemId` can only
be found by comparing bubble text against queue row text. Consequently:

readme.section: Three write paths, ordered by cost
Three write paths, ordered by cost
readme.text:
The error-code table was verified one by one against the host's `updateQueue`
handler in `dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js` (lines 822-845) — nothing was copied from another plugin.

readme.section: Three write paths, ordered by cost
readme.text:
The door the host *does* leave open is **message projection**: pure functions registered
per event type, deciding at fold time what the model sees for a given seq. So v3 appends
one private event, `reply-forge/patch` (pure log record, never enters the surface), and a
same-type projection rewrites the target message.

readme.section: Three write paths, ordered by cost
Three write paths, ordered by cost
readme.text:
**About host upgrades (since v3.4.1)**: when host 0.2.1 reads a v3-generation session
file it runs a format migration that renames every "unknown type + `ignorable`" event to
`plugin:<original type>` and writes it back — our `reply-forge/patch` becomes
`plugin:reply-forge/patch`. Projections match event types exactly, so this plugin
**registers and accepts both types** (the `projectedTextsOf` projection baseline and the
version-lineage derivation likewise accept both); new events still use the old type,
which never triggers the rename. Users who upgraded DSH keep their forges and version
chains in old sessions.

```bash
node tests/projection.test.mjs   # mechanism on the real dsh-session host (SKIP if no host)
node tests/persistence.test.mjs  # P0: real-host persistence loop, create→append→flush→re-read→gate
node tests/ignorable.test.mjs    # P0: ignorable shim + per-session write-handle verification
node tests/live.test.mjs         # online layer validation and failure codes

**423 assertions in 17 suites** — including P0's `ignorable` (29), the real-host
persistence loop (5), `session-repair` (15), v3.4's `lineage` (22), v3.4.1's
`migration-rename` (5) and the upgrade self-check's own `verify-host` (21).
**31 of them** (`projection` 18 + `migration-rename` 5 +
`persistence` 5 + `ignorable` 3) need the host package `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`
and its codec chain installed; without it they SKIP (not fail), so the release
zip stays green on machines without DSH (392 assertions execute in that mode) — with a
host present, all 423 run.
Or just run the gate:

```bash
node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"
npm test
```

After touching `.dsh-plugin/client/*.mjs` you must rebuild the artifact
(`node scripts/build-client.mjs` — a self-written inliner, zero dependencies, no JSX, no
export default); `build.test.mjs` asserts artifact and source stay byte-identical
(`npm run check`).

A host upgrade can **silently** change the interfaces this plugin depends on — that is
exactly how v3.4's migration-rename bug slipped through (no error, no warning; forges
quietly fell back to the original text). After upgrading DSH, run from the source tree:

```bash
npm run verify-host        # T0 version baseline + T1 contract surface (forces host-gated suites; no host = FAIL)
node scripts/verify-host.mjs --boot   # + T2 boot smoke
node scripts/verify-host.mjs --live   # + T3 live CDP
```

Version drift from the pinned `host-baseline.json` → WARN (usually harmless — just
register the new baseline); any failed layer → FAIL with exit code 1. Full walkthrough
in [使用说明.md](./使用说明.md) §7 (Chinese).

Two extra guards and one alternative backend:

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `node scripts/lint-flat.mjs` | **Flatten guard**: checks for top-level identifiers that collide across client modules (flattening into a single file makes them silently overwrite each other — syntax checks cannot see it), plus syntax the inliner cannot handle |
| `node scripts/build-client-esbuild.mjs` | **esbuild backend (optional)**: writes only a preview (`client.esbuild.js`) by default; add `--write` to replace the real artifact |

`build-release.mjs` runs both guards before packing and aborts on failure. The esbuild
output is verified **behaviourally equivalent** (57/57 client tests, same
`{ name, inject, apply }` exports), but it needs `npx` to fetch the package, so the
zero-dependency inliner remains the default. Switching is an explicit `--write`, not a slip.

Don't feel like the UI? Edit the files directly (quit DSH first):

```bash
node scripts/forge-session.mjs --session <id> --list
node scripts/forge-session.mjs --session <id> --list --kind reasoning   # list thinking blocks
node scripts/forge-session.mjs --session <id> --seq 42 --block-index 1 \
  --kind text --text "the rewritten reply" --dry-run

`--kind` takes `text` / `reasoning` / `both` (default `text`); `--list` filters by it —
so grab a thinking block's `seq`/`blockIndex` with `--list --kind reasoning` before
forging.

`scripts/diag-focus.mjs` — unattended reproduction of the classic "no cursor after save"
bug: boots the real host in Node (mirroring the app's boot recipe), opens the page in
headless Edge via CDP, runs "Forge → render locally", and samples `activeElement` plus
focusin/focusout trajectories the whole way. Run it with
`CODEBUDDY_SAFE_DELETE_ENABLED=0 node scripts/diag-focus.mjs` (the safe-delete shim
otherwise blocks the host's lock-file cleanup).
